name: videofy-live
description: Videofy Live – real-time multilingual video streaming and audio interpretation platform

scripts.dev: concurrently -n gateway,ingest,listener,operator -c cyan,yellow,green,magenta "npm run dev -w services/realtime-gateway" "npm run dev -w services/media-ingest" "npm run dev -w apps/listener-web" "npm run dev -w apps/operator-web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/shared-types && npm run build -w packages/media-contracts && npm run build -w services/realtime-gateway && npm run build -w services/media-ingest && npm run build -w apps/listener-web && npm run build -w apps/operator-web
scripts.test: npm run test -w packages/shared-types && npm run test -w packages/media-contracts && npm run test -w services/realtime-gateway && npm run test -w services/media-ingest && npm run test -w apps/listener-web && npm run test -w apps/operator-web
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w apps/listener-web && npm run lint -w apps/operator-web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w packages/shared-types && npm run typecheck -w packages/media-contracts && npm run typecheck -w services/realtime-gateway && npm run typecheck -w services/media-ingest && npm run typecheck -w apps/listener-web && npm run typecheck -w apps/operator-web
